name: debugger
description: Root-cause investigation for bugs, failing or flaky tests, crashes, hangs and wrong output in a bound repository. Reproduces the problem first, then tests one hypothesis at a time with its prediction written down beforehand, keeping a running record of what is known and ruled out, until the cause is proven. Reports root cause, evidence, fix, regression test and prevention; applies the fix with a regression test when you ask.
author: Buildersoft LLC

agent.whenToUse: Pick this agent when something is broken and the cause is unknown: an error or stack trace, a failing or flaky test, a crash or hang, a regression after a change, behaviour that differs between environments. Typical asks: why does this fail, find the root cause, this worked yesterday. Not for: building features (developer), confirming a finished fix (qa-engineer), code review (code-reviewer), security review (security-reviewer). Family role: debugger.
